bibliographic.title: il pallone da calcio
bibliographic.author: radicalhoodie
bibliographic.description:
a short and silly story about about being accused for something you didn't do (and meeting a short and silly person).

contains:
> 499 words
> a couple of choices
> character portraits!!!!
> only one ending

basically a spin-off from ama me (in incisis), where Giò's first mentioned - this game does contain a tiny spoiler for it though (after the choice "That depends. Who's asking?"); it can be played by itself but it might make more sense if you've played the other one.

i got part of the code for implementing the images from @isolatedphenomenon's Disco Elysium Inkjs Template!! i didnt get it to work like theirs but i couldnt have done it without them :)written for the neo-twiny jam 2025.
